Feed post
Jordan Blake
Keynote speaker • 3rd
5h
I got rejected.
Not once.
Not twice.
Eleven times.
And then something changed.
I stopped selling.
I started listening.
On the next call I said nothing for a full minute.
They talked.
They told me exactly what they needed.
I closed the deal that week.
Here is what nobody tells you.
Silence is leverage.
